$comment: Shared sample-screen manifest for the context family (shots tool). One source for page names, demo conversation, model capability metadata, ledger manifests, checkpoints and per-page presets across iOS, Android debug and Web dev shot entries. All three ends render the same values (iOS is the gold reference) and never write a real store, touch the network. Capability values (window, max output, long-context price line, pricing) exist ONLY in `models`, written in the Server /api/metadata model-entry shape under the Server provider key (`provider`, e.g. grok / openAI / openRouter, no per-end name mapping) (metadataModelResponse: contextLength / maxOutputTokens / pricing{promptPerMToken, completionPerMToken, longContext{thresholdTokens, promptPerMToken, completionPerMToken}} / pricingStatus); every end decodes them with its production metadata decoder and lets production code derive W, B, the price line and costs. No end may hardcode a window or price-line number or guess it from the model id; a missing contextLength means window unknown. The Server delivers no windowKind, so every end uses its production default. Ledger manifests follow shared/context-contracts/usage.v1.json, checkpoints follow checkpoint.v1.json (summary uses constants.headings; ends build the record through their production serializer), confirm inputs follow context-cap-confirm.v1.json; `$source` names the contract case each preset mirrors. Keys starting with '$' are documentation and ignored by readers.

messages.content: I'm planning five days in Lisbon in November. Where should I start?
Start with the old town: Alfama and Baixa are walkable and close to the river.
Is it worth getting the Lisboa Card?
If you plan three or more museums plus trams, yes. Otherwise pay per ride.
Which day trip is better, Sintra or Cascais?
Sintra for palaces and forest walks, Cascais for a slow beach day.
Let's do Sintra on day three.
Done. Take an early train from Rossio to beat the crowds.
Suggest a dinner spot near Alfama.
Try a small tasca with fado in the evening; book a table for 8 pm.
Now draft the full itinerary for all five days.
Day 1: Alfama and the castle. Day 2: Belém and the riverside. Day 3: Sintra. Day 4: LX Factory and Bairro Alto. Day 5: a slow morning in Príncipe Real.

$pages: Every page opens conversation conv-lisbon on the given model unless messages is 'none' (a new empty conversation). manifest = one ledger row written at clock minus 1 minute for the last assistant message. checkpoint = one stored checkpoint of that kind; compactionCount = how many checkpoints the conversation has (3 raises the third-compaction hint); the extra older ones cover u1..a2 and u1..a3 with the same createdAt, so the named checkpoint (u1..a4) stays the latest valid one. Appended suggestion messages: user at their createdAt, assistant 30 s later. preferences: aiSummary = 'when over limit' mode (false = keep only your messages, the default), defaultCap = Settings default cap ('auto' default), priceLineReminder (default true). conversationCap: null follows the global setting, 'auto' / 'unlimited' / a number. open names what is shown on top of the chat page: panel / picker (opened from the panel) / detail (checkpoint detail from the divider) / conversationSettings / confirm / settings (Settings > Context, no chat page). lastAssistantStopReason sets stopReason on a6. directiveSuggestion / memorySuggestion append a user message plus an assistant reply after a6 and raise the production suggestion for it.
